# Love in Africa

> Romantic travel guides for Africa: honeymoon destinations, Zanzibar, safari honeymoons, destination weddings, African wedding traditions and sample itineraries for couples.

Love in Africa is an editorial travel and culture site for couples. It is not a dating site and does not sell travel. Wedding legal information is general and points to official registries.

## Pages

- [Home](https://loveinafrica.com/): Overview with links to every honeymoon, wedding and itinerary guide, plus an FAQ for couples.
- [The Best African Honeymoon Destinations](https://loveinafrica.com/african-honeymoon-destinations.html): Zanzibar, Seychelles, Mauritius, the Cape Winelands and more, compared by style, season and mood.
- [Zanzibar Honeymoon Guide: Beaches, Stone Town and Spice](https://loveinafrica.com/zanzibar-honeymoon-guide.html): Which coast to choose, how the tides work, what to do and how to travel respectfully as a couple.
- [Safari Honeymoon Guide: Planning a Romantic Bush-and-Beach Trip](https://loveinafrica.com/safari-honeymoon-guide.html): Romantic camp choices, special experiences and the best ways to pair a safari with a beach.
- [Destination Weddings in Africa: How to Plan One](https://loveinafrica.com/destination-weddings-in-africa.html): Legal vs symbolic ceremonies, paperwork, venues, guest logistics and timelines for marrying in Africa.
- [African Wedding Traditions: A Respectful Introduction](https://loveinafrica.com/african-wedding-traditions.html): Lobola, Nigerian and Ghanaian ceremonies, Moroccan henna nights, and how to honor traditions thoughtfully.
- [Romantic Africa Itineraries: Six Sample Trips for Couples](https://loveinafrica.com/romantic-africa-itineraries.html): Day-by-day outlines for honeymoons and anniversaries, from Serengeti-and-Zanzibar to Morocco.
